directive.gatingQuestion: Does Intel's Q2 2026 large GAAP net loss contradict the reported operating turnaround, or is the gap principally attributable to identifiable non-operating/one-time items while Foundry remains structurally loss-making?
directive.whyItMatters: The promotion packet routes the unresolved material contradiction to deep-resolver; leaving headline revenue/operating improvement versus GAAP loss unexplained blocks clean evidence interpretation.
directive.preferredPrimarySource: Intel Q2 2026 Form 10-Q and issuer Q2 2026 financial-results reconciliation
directive.successCondition: Primary-source reconciliation establishes whether Q2 GAAP loss is driven by core operating deterioration or separately identifiable items, while preserving Foundry economics as a distinct risk/unknown.

evidence.statement: Q2 2026 revenue was $16.128B and GAAP operating income was $1.796B (11.1% margin), versus Q2 2025 operating loss of $3.176B.

Q2 2026 GAAP net loss attributable to Intel was $11.033B, while non-GAAP net income attributable to Intel was $2.197B. The reconciliation includes $12.529B of losses on mark-to-market of Escrowed Shares among the adjustments.

The Form 10-Q reports Q2 Intel Foundry revenue of $5.765B and operating loss of $2.089B (-36%), improved from a $3.168B loss (-72%) a year earlier; substantially all Foundry business currently supports internal manufacturing, with a more significant external business still an aim.

resolution.inference: The two packet contradictions are not evidence of a Q2 core-operating collapse: Intel was GAAP operating-profitable in the quarter, and the enormous gap to GAAP net loss is dominated by a separately disclosed mark-to-market loss on Escrowed Shares. However, this does not normalize away Foundry economics: Foundry remained deeply operating-loss-making despite year-over-year improvement. The correct two-sided interpretation is operating turnaround plus a non-operating GAAP distortion, alongside a still-material Foundry profitability/external-customer uncertainty.
resolution.gateImpact: Resolve the routed unresolved_material_contradiction. Do not treat this resolution as evidence that Foundry profitability, 18A external utilization, valuation, missing specialist coverage, causal mapping, score record, or data-confidence gates are resolved.
resolution.recommendedNextState: Mark the two headline-growth-versus-GAAP-loss contradictions resolved/superseded by this reconciliation; preserve Foundry loss and external-customer economics as risk/unknown for the appropriate underwriting lanes.
